summary: Verified 7.0/10, NOT ON PAR (under 7.5, no blocker open). I checked all three splashes, all three portraits, the 48 px icon and the game-camera crop myself. Both majors are confirmed. The splash plate is reused: the left 45% of base vs Gorgewalk correlates at 0.895 (greyscale 400x225). Shadeprint is the same waterfall, spires and domes re-framed and re-graded (corr 0.51 because of the shift). Gorgewalk's boots hang over the chasm with no contact. The own-screen rack-top L* re-measures at 84.2 (box 868,425-880,440 on gfx_ro_hesmi_high_base_game0.png, 1920x1080). Sensitivity is clean: the hood is round and flat-crowned on base, Gorgewalk and Shadeprint; the face is a cloth wrap with two eye slits, not horror, hockey mask or mannequin. The Gorgewalk portrait's pale wrap is the closest to a blank mask, but the cloth folds under the eyes keep it reading as fabric, so it is not a blocker. The tall pointed shapes in the splash plate are background architecture, not hoods. The model and animation are near par. The cards hold the score down.

findings.title: All three splashes are filtered model renders on one shared vista plate; fists and wraps smear
findings.what: Base, Gorgewalk and Shadeprint use the same waterfall, spire and dome plate, only re-graded or re-framed. The posterise filter blobs the gauntlets and fists and flattens the wraps.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/hesmi/splash.png, hesmi_gorgewalk_splash.png, hesmi_shadeprint_splash.png viewed. Greyscale corr of the left 45% (400x225): base-gorgewalk 0.895, base-shadeprint 0.509 (same plate shifted), gorgewalk-shadeprint 0.480. Script: scratchpad m.mjs (sharp).
findings.gauge: LoL skin splashes are painted illustrations, each with its own themed environment; skins never share one background.
findings.fix: VALE-own plate per skin from WORLD.md places, plus a hand paint-over of the hands and face in place of the global posterise filter (see reviewer fix).
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced by eye and numerically. Severity holds: the splash is the main sales and collection image.

findings.title: Skin splash staging misses the brief; the Gorgewalk figure floats with no ground contact
findings.what: Gorgewalk's feet (about y 600-700) hang over the chasm with no plank, ledge or contact shadow. Shadeprint is a forward crouch with the arms at the waist, not Felled Shard's overhead lift. Base is an eye-level stoop, not the low-camera two-fisted stab. Neither skin gets the sky the brief promises.
findings.gauge: LoL splashes ground the champion and stage the skin's signature moment.
findings.fix: As the reviewer proposes: re-pose Shadeprint on cast_ult with the gauntlets overhead, put Gorgewalk on a rope-bridge plank with a baked contact shadow, and re-take base low on cast_a1.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed. A floating figure is the most visible defect on the card. It is a major, not a blocker, because it is not a sensitivity issue and does not affect function.

findings.title: At the game camera the face is a blank pale hood dome
findings.what: From the game camera the eye-band is hidden and the hood reads as a pale dome with a white crescent.
findings.gauge: Hooded LoL champions keep a facing cue at gameplay zoom.
findings.fix: Bring the eye-band forward of the brim and darken the brim lip.
findings.verifierNote: Seen. Facing still reads from the fists and the rack, so it stays minor.

findings.title: Brown/orange hood-cavity wedge reads as a scalp above the eye-band
findings.what: In the base portrait and splash a warm rust crescent sits above the eye-band.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/hesmi/portrait.png (about x 150-240, y 170-215). It is absent on the Gorgewalk and Shadeprint portraits.
findings.gauge: LoL hood interiors fall to cool shadow.
findings.fix: Re-hue the cavity toward the cool linen shade.
findings.verifierNote: Visible in the base portrait only.

findings.fix: Ink ring around each inlay; limit the self tint to the inner area.

findings.gauge: Small overlap on strap ends sells weight on landings.
